image_note: The reset image writes FC61, waits 60000 PHY clocks (1 ms), then reads FC once and requires Reset=0 and FC41 before the phases. Same four synchronous ULPI termination phases as the extended termination image (100 ms settle, 10 ms gaps). Page 0 holds the last unsolicited RxCmd byte per phase; page 3 holds per-phase RxCmd LineState seen masks. A zero mask means no observed event, not SE0. Register responses and turnaround cycles are excluded. Phase histories include configuration writes, intermediate detach, settle and sample gaps; they are not restricted to the settled Debug15 sample window. Last bytes have no timestamp or freshness marker. Only phase-scoped events enter these histories; the global RxCmd/RxData summaries include other eligible cycles and are not packet counts. Global totals may keep increasing after DONE, while phase histories stop updating. Debug15 samples remain on page 2. No USB device protocol runs, and the final state is detached.
note: CSV time labels are retained as exported; they do not establish USB bit timing. CSV contains no GAO ID; select the image layout matching the capture record. Each complete 0,1,2,3 cycle contains eight samples per page and is coherent because the observer commits its 128-bit mailbox only before page 0. There is no snapshot sequence or freshness flag: a capture need not contain a newly acknowledged snapshot, and repeated page cycles may show the same previous snapshot. Before any 60 MHz acknowledgement, payload pages are zero. The clock count is a separate 10 ms measurement; zero persists after a full stopped-clock window. This is not a complete ULPI or USB protocol trace.
